comments.author: sandesh-sp
comments.body:
@dzole0311 Regarding the UI observations, I think we also need to conditionally render the sections within the tabs. I created a new field for layout/styling called mission mode which can be either 'classic' or 'modern'. Both mode and renderer will impact which tabs (and sections within it) will be present on the configuration page.

We will probably need to decide how to handle all these additional configurations:
1. Expose everything on the configure page, and conditionally expose/hide tabs and sections like @dzole0311 suggested. This will require some additional work on the configuration page.
2. Only expose some of the configurations that are relevant to user and directly modify mission config json file for the rest (for the September deliverable)

We should also decide if we will be creating on our own tool builder on top of MMGIS core instead of relying on the configuration page in future. And if yes, will that impact the modifications we'll be making on current configuration  page.
